metadata.title: आदिवासी कैसे बनाते हैं निमाड़ की मशहूर दाल बाटी । Special Daal Baati of Nimad । Daal Baati Recipe
metadata.description:
You must have heard a lot about the Daal Baati and Litti Chokha of Rajasthan and Bihar. But we discovered that Daal Baati is a very popular dish in tribal areas of Nimad, Madhya Pradesh. We were invited by a tribal family to have dinner with them in a small village in Barwani district. We not only had this delicious food, but witnessed the whole process.

#Daalbaati  #Daal_Baati_recipe
